reading: Robert Pattinson, known for Twilight and The Batman, has been selected as the next James Bond.
Amazon MGM Studios revealed the casting in a social media post accompanied by an image of Pattinson as 007.
The 40-year-old will become the seventh actor to portray Bond, with the next film expected in 2028.
Denis Villeneuve will direct and Steven Knight will write the film, although its title and exact release date remain unannounced.
The casting follows years of speculation surrounding one of entertainment’s most highly scrutinised roles.
Amazon MGM chose an established, bankable star who is widely regarded as a safe pair of hands.
Pattinson’s fearlessness, self-deprecating wit and ability to reinvent himself were praised as qualities that suit him to Bond.
Although reports suggested that his agreement committed him to three films, that detail has not been officially confirmed.
Pattinson first rose to prominence as Cedric Diggory in the 2005 film Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire.
His five Twilight films alongside Kristen Stewart collectively earned more than $3 billion worldwide.
He has also earned respect for taking roles in smaller productions, including experimental and arthouse films.
In 2025, Barbara Broccoli and Michael G Wilson agreed to sell creative control of the franchise to Amazon MGM.
The Broccoli family had controlled the series since 1962, when Sean Connery first appeared as Bond.
For decades, the family protected the character’s integrity while resisting spin-offs and licensing.
Some industry experts expect these forms of expansion to follow Amazon’s takeover.
If the next Bond film opens in 2028 as expected, about seven years will have passed since No Time To Die by the time it is released, making this the longest gap in the franchise’s history.

vocabulary.definition: Examined closely and critically, with considerable attention paid to choices and performance.
Considered likely to attract audiences and generate revenue, especially through an established reputation.
Someone trusted to handle an important responsibility competently and reliably.
Clever humour that gently makes fun of the speaker’s own qualities or limitations.
Develop a substantially different professional identity or approach instead of remaining associated with one established image.
Describing films that emphasise artistic expression or unconventional approaches rather than broad commercial appeal.
Authority over artistic decisions, such as how characters and stories are developed.
A connected series of films together with its recurring characters, identity and associated commercial rights.
The preservation of a character’s essential qualities and consistency.
New productions developed from an existing series, often focusing on a related character or setting.
The practice of granting others permission to use protected characters, names or other material commercially.

entries.ja: 選択や演技に大きな注意が払われ、細かく批判的に検討されること。
entries.ko: 선택과 연기에 상당한 관심이 쏠리며 면밀하고 비판적으로 검토되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 受到细致而带有批判性的审视，其选择和表现得到高度关注。
entries.es: Examinado de cerca y con sentido crítico, prestando considerable atención a las decisiones y al desempeño.
entries.pt-BR: Examinado de perto e de forma crítica, com bastante atenção às escolhas e ao desempenho.
entries.fr: Examiné de près et avec un regard critique, en accordant une grande attention aux choix et à la prestation.
entries.de: Genau und kritisch geprüft, wobei Entscheidungen und Leistungen große Aufmerksamkeit erhalten.

entries.ja: 特にすでに築いた評判によって、観客を引きつけ、収益を生み出す可能性が高いと考えられること。
entries.ko: 특히 이미 쌓아 온 명성을 바탕으로 관객을 끌어들이고 수익을 창출할 가능성이 높다고 여겨지는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 被认为很可能吸引观众并带来收入，尤其是凭借已经建立的声誉。
entries.es: De quien se considera que tiene muchas probabilidades de atraer público y generar ingresos, especialmente gracias a una reputación consolidada.
entries.pt-BR: Considerado com boas chances de atrair público e gerar receita, especialmente por ter uma reputação consolidada.
entries.fr: Considéré comme ayant de fortes chances d’attirer le public et de générer des revenus, notamment grâce à une réputation bien établie.
entries.de: Als jemand angesehen, der wahrscheinlich Publikum anzieht und Einnahmen erzielt, besonders aufgrund eines bereits etablierten Rufs.

entries.ja: 重要な責任を、十分な能力をもって確実に果たしてくれると信頼されている人。
entries.ko: 중요한 책임을 유능하고 믿음직하게 수행할 것이라고 신뢰받는 사람.
entries.zh-Hans: 被信任能够胜任并可靠地履行重要职责的人。
entries.es: Persona en quien se confía para cumplir una responsabilidad importante con competencia y fiabilidad.
entries.pt-BR: Alguém em quem se confia para cumprir uma responsabilidade importante com competência e de maneira confiável.
entries.fr: Personne à qui l’on fait confiance pour assumer une responsabilité importante avec compétence et fiabilité.
entries.de: Eine Person, der man zutraut, eine wichtige Verantwortung kompetent und zuverlässig wahrzunehmen.

entries.ja: 話し手が自分自身の特徴や至らない点を、軽くからかう気の利いたユーモア。
entries.ko: 말하는 사람이 자신의 특성이나 부족한 점을 가볍게 놀리는 재치 있는 유머.
entries.zh-Hans: 说话者温和地调侃自身特点或不足的机智幽默。
entries.es: Humor ingenioso con el que quien habla se burla suavemente de sus propias cualidades o limitaciones.
entries.pt-BR: Humor inteligente que faz brincadeiras leves com as próprias características ou limitações de quem fala.
entries.fr: Humour fin par lequel une personne se moque gentiment de ses propres traits ou limites.
entries.de: Geistreicher Humor, mit dem die sprechende Person ihre eigenen Eigenschaften oder Grenzen auf sanfte Weise auf die Schippe nimmt.

entries.ja: すでに定着した一つのイメージに結びついたままでいるのではなく、仕事上の自分のあり方や取り組み方を大きく変えること。
entries.ko: 이미 굳어진 하나의 이미지에 머무르지 않고 직업적 정체성이나 접근 방식을 크게 바꾸어 나가는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 形成与以往明显不同的职业形象或做事方式，而不是始终与某个既定形象联系在一起。
entries.es: Desarrollar una identidad profesional o una manera de trabajar sustancialmente diferente, en lugar de seguir asociado a una única imagen ya establecida.
entries.pt-BR: Desenvolver uma identidade profissional ou uma forma de trabalhar bastante diferente, em vez de continuar associado a uma única imagem já estabelecida.
entries.fr: Développer une identité professionnelle ou une approche sensiblement différente, au lieu de rester associé à une seule image déjà établie.
entries.de: Eine wesentlich andere berufliche Identität oder Herangehensweise entwickeln, anstatt weiterhin mit einem einzigen etablierten Bild verbunden zu bleiben.

entries.ja: 幅広い層への商業的な訴求力よりも、芸術的な表現や型にはまらない手法を重視する映画を表すこと。
entries.ko: 폭넓은 대중에게 상업적으로 어필하는 것보다 예술적 표현이나 관습에 얽매이지 않는 접근 방식을 강조하는 영화를 가리키는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 形容注重艺术表达或非传统手法，而非广泛商业吸引力的电影。
entries.es: Que describe películas que dan prioridad a la expresión artística o a enfoques poco convencionales, en vez de buscar un amplio atractivo comercial.
entries.pt-BR: Que descreve filmes que dão mais importância à expressão artística ou a abordagens pouco convencionais do que ao apelo comercial para um público amplo.
entries.fr: Qualifie des films qui privilégient l’expression artistique ou des approches non conventionnelles plutôt qu’un large attrait commercial.
entries.de: Bezeichnet Filme, die künstlerischen Ausdruck oder unkonventionelle Ansätze stärker betonen als ihre kommerzielle Attraktivität für ein breites Publikum.

entries.ja: 登場人物や物語をどのように発展させるかなど、芸術的な判断を下す権限。
entries.ko: 등장인물과 이야기를 어떻게 발전시킬지 등 예술적 결정을 내릴 권한.
entries.zh-Hans: 对艺术创作方面的决定拥有的权力，例如如何塑造人物和发展故事。
entries.es: Autoridad para tomar decisiones artísticas, como la manera de desarrollar los personajes y las historias.
entries.pt-BR: Autoridade para tomar decisões artísticas, como a maneira de desenvolver personagens e histórias.
entries.fr: Pouvoir de prendre les décisions artistiques, notamment sur la manière de développer les personnages et les histoires.
entries.de: Die Befugnis, künstlerische Entscheidungen zu treffen, etwa darüber, wie Figuren und Geschichten entwickelt werden.

entries.ja: 互いにつながりのある一連の映画と、そこに繰り返し登場する人物、シリーズ独自の特徴、および関連する商業上の権利を合わせたもの。
entries.ko: 서로 연결된 일련의 영화와 그 안에 반복해서 등장하는 인물, 시리즈 고유의 정체성 및 관련 상업적 권리를 아우르는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 一组相互关联的系列电影，以及其中反复出现的人物、系列的独特形象和相关商业权利。
entries.es: Conjunto de películas relacionadas entre sí, junto con sus personajes recurrentes, su identidad y los derechos comerciales asociados.
entries.pt-BR: Conjunto de filmes ligados entre si, incluindo seus personagens recorrentes, sua identidade e os direitos comerciais associados.
entries.fr: Ensemble de films liés entre eux, avec leurs personnages récurrents, leur identité et les droits commerciaux qui leur sont associés.
entries.de: Eine zusammenhängende Filmreihe samt ihren wiederkehrenden Figuren, ihrer eigenen Identität und den damit verbundenen kommerziellen Rechten.

entries.ja: 登場人物の本質的な特徴と一貫性が保たれること。
entries.ko: 등장인물의 본질적인 특성과 일관성을 지키는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 对一个角色的核心特质和一致性的维护。
entries.es: Preservación de las cualidades esenciales y la coherencia de un personaje.
entries.pt-BR: Preservação das características essenciais e da coerência de um personagem.
entries.fr: Préservation des qualités essentielles et de la cohérence d’un personnage.
entries.de: Die Bewahrung der wesentlichen Eigenschaften und der Stimmigkeit einer Figur.

entries.ja: 既存のシリーズから生まれた新しい作品で、多くの場合、関連する登場人物や舞台に焦点を当てたもの。
entries.ko: 기존 시리즈에서 파생된 새로운 작품들로, 흔히 관련 인물이나 배경에 초점을 맞추는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 从现有系列发展而来的新作品，通常围绕相关人物或故事背景展开。
entries.es: Nuevas producciones derivadas de una serie existente, que a menudo se centran en un personaje o un entorno relacionado con ella.
entries.pt-BR: Novas produções derivadas de uma série existente, muitas vezes centradas em um personagem ou cenário relacionado a ela.
entries.fr: Nouvelles productions issues d’une série existante, souvent centrées sur un personnage ou un cadre qui lui est lié.
entries.de: Neue Produktionen, die aus einer bestehenden Reihe hervorgehen und sich häufig auf eine damit verbundene Figur oder einen entsprechenden Schauplatz konzentrieren.

entries.ja: 権利で保護されている登場人物や名称、その他の素材を、他者が商業目的で利用することを許可する行為。
entries.ko: 권리로 보호되는 등장인물, 이름 또는 기타 자료를 다른 사람이 상업적으로 사용할 수 있도록 허가하는 행위.
entries.zh-Hans: 允许他人将受权利保护的人物、名称或其他素材用于商业用途的做法。
entries.es: Práctica de conceder a otros permiso para utilizar comercialmente personajes, nombres u otros materiales protegidos por derechos.
entries.pt-BR: Prática de conceder a outros permissão para usar comercialmente personagens, nomes ou outros materiais protegidos por direitos.
entries.fr: Pratique consistant à autoriser d’autres personnes à utiliser commercialement des personnages, des noms ou d’autres éléments protégés par des droits.
entries.de: Die Praxis, anderen die Erlaubnis zu erteilen, rechtlich geschützte Figuren, Namen oder andere Inhalte kommerziell zu nutzen.

review.method: Context-only editorial carry-forward: release-year certainty does not change any vocabulary term, sense, or definition; all seven existing translations retained verbatim. No translation generation.

previous_review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
